name: quality-data-core
description: Quality Data core: platform and the data quality module

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @knime-orchestador/shared --filter @knime-orchestador/api-client --filter @knime-orchestador/feature-kit run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.gen:api: pnpm run gen:openapi && pnpm run gen:api-client
scripts.check:api: pnpm run gen:api && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.ts
scripts.check:grafana: pnpm run gen:grafana && git diff --exit-code -- infra/observability/grafana/dashboards infra/observability/grafana/provisioning/alerting && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- infra/observability/grafana/dashboards infra/observability/grafana/provisioning/alerting | (! grep .)
